indicators.note: Published/derived only where a real series exists; never inherit a parent value.

indicators.name: Population, 2009 census
indicators.description: County population from the 2009 census, surfaced as its own fixed profile slot.
indicators.note: County only; generated from the already-ingested 2009 population observations.

indicators.name: Average household size
indicators.description: Average number of persons per household.
indicators.note: Constituency alignment must be verified before activation.

indicators.name: Literacy rate
indicators.description: Share of the relevant population meeting the published literacy definition.
indicators.note: County only until a valid lower-level tabulation is confirmed.

indicators.name: Poverty rate (monetary)
indicators.description: Overall monetary poverty headcount rate.
indicators.note: County survey estimate; sampling uncertainty required when activated.

indicators.name: Dwelling wall/roof material (% permanent)
indicators.description: Share of dwellings classified as permanent by the published census material definition.
indicators.note: County only.
Cross-listed in Representation below county.

indicators.name: Disability prevalence (Washington Group short set)
indicators.description: Prevalence using the Washington Group short-set disability identification questions.
indicators.note: County census indicator.

indicators.name: Inua Jamii cash-transfer beneficiaries
indicators.description: Beneficiaries of Older Persons, OVC, Persons with Severe Disability and HSNP schemes.
indicators.note: No citable per-county publication identified; must not be promoted to sourced without one.

indicators.name: Mean KCPE / KCSE score
indicators.description: County-level mean examination performance, only if a genuine KNEC primary table is located.
indicators.note: Do not source from blogs/news aggregations; retire if no primary county table exists.

indicators.name: Licensed businesses (count, year-on-year change)
indicators.description: Licensed business count and year-on-year change where a county publishes a usable series.
indicators.note: Coverage is inconsistent; ingest opportunistically and never manufacture missing counties.

indicators.name: Key crop production (county-dominant crop only)
indicators.description: Production of the county-dominant crop where a comparable official table exists.
indicators.source: KNBS Economic Survey / Ministry of Agriculture
indicators.note: Crop and unit vary; requires indicator-specific ingestion before activation.

indicators.name: Health facility count (by type/ownership)
indicators.description: Count of registered health facilities by type/ownership.
indicators.note: Official registry; profile count is derived from registered facility records.

indicators.name: Stunting rate, under-5
indicators.description: Share of children under five classified as stunted.
indicators.note: Sample survey; confidence interval/SE/sample size required when active.

indicators.name: Full immunization coverage
indicators.description: Published full immunization coverage rate.
indicators.note: Sample survey; confidence interval/SE/sample size required when active.

indicators.name: Skilled birth attendance rate
indicators.description: Share of births attended by skilled health personnel.
indicators.note: Sample survey; confidence interval/SE/sample size required when active.

indicators.name: HIV prevalence
indicators.description: Published HIV prevalence estimate.
indicators.note: Sample survey; confidence interval/SE/sample size required when active.

indicators.name: Facilities with electricity/water (%)
indicators.description: Share of facilities with electricity/water in the Kenya Health Facility Census snapshot.
indicators.note: One-off snapshot; label prominently as a snapshot if activated.

indicators.name: Teenage pregnancy rate, age 15–19
indicators.description: Published teenage pregnancy rate among ages 15–19.
indicators.note: Sample survey; plain statistic only, no worst-county ranking.

indicators.name: Home births (vs. facility births)
indicators.description: Share of births occurring at home.
indicators.note: Sample survey; confidence interval/SE/sample size required when active.

indicators.name: Modern contraceptive use rate
indicators.description: Published modern contraceptive use rate.
indicators.note: Sample survey; confidence interval/SE/sample size required when active.

indicators.name: FGM prevalence / child marriage rate
indicators.description: Published prevalence measure, presented neutrally without editorial ranking.
indicators.note: Sample survey; never render as a shame/worst-offender ranking.

indicators.name: Drug and substance use prevalence
indicators.description: Published prevalence from the NACADA national survey, subject to verification of county coverage.
indicators.source: NACADA National Survey on the Status of Drugs and Substance Use in Kenya 2022
indicators.note: Do not activate until the newest round's county coverage is verified; sampling uncertainty is mandatory.

indicators.name: Hospital bed occupancy/utilisation rate
indicators.description: Hospital bed utilisation if a public Kenyan source is identified.
indicators.note: No confirmed public Kenyan feed; remain planned until a citable source exists.

indicators.name: Food security phase classification (IPC-style)
indicators.description: Acute food insecurity phase classification from seasonal assessments.
indicators.source: National Drought Management Authority (NDMA) seasonal food security assessment
indicators.note: County conditional; NDMA assessment coverage is institutional, not a temporary data gap.

indicators.name: Drought early warning bulletin status
indicators.description: Monthly drought early warning status from NDMA bulletins.
indicators.source: NDMA monthly drought early warning bulletins
indicators.note: Machine-readable table structure not yet reviewed.

indicators.name: Rainfall and temperature (historical series)
indicators.description: Historical rainfall and temperature where an official open-data channel exists.
indicators.note: Remain planned unless a genuine historical-data channel is confirmed.

indicators.name: Own-source revenue vs. target
indicators.description: County own-source revenue performance against target.
indicators.source: Office of the Controller of Budget County Budget Implementation Review Report FY2024/25
indicators.note: Same trusted report family as budget/expenditure; first-priority sourced promotion.

indicators.name: Pending bills
indicators.description: County pending bills reported by the Controller of Budget.
indicators.source: Office of the Controller of Budget County Budget Implementation Review Report FY2024/25
indicators.note: Same trusted report family as budget/expenditure; first-priority sourced promotion.

indicators.name: Auditor-General opinion
indicators.description: County audit opinion: unqualified, qualified, adverse or disclaimer.
indicators.source: Office of the Auditor-General Summary Report on County Governments 2024/2025
indicators.note: Categorical audit opinion; do not turn into an unsupported composite score.

indicators.name: Member of Parliament (name, party)
indicators.description: Current constituency Member of Parliament identity and party, once a checkable source is curated.
indicators.note: No single confirmed machine-readable source; remain planned.

indicators.name: Member of County Assembly (name, party)
indicators.description: Current ward MCA identity and party, once a checkable source is curated.
indicators.note: No single confirmed machine-readable source; remain planned.

indicators.name: NG-CDF allocation (financial year)
indicators.description: Constituency NG-CDF allocation for the financial year.
indicators.note: Do not promote until a specific citable report/page is identified.

indicators.name: NG-CDF utilization rate
indicators.description: Constituency NG-CDF utilization rate.
indicators.note: Do not promote until a specific citable report/page is identified.

indicators.name: Ward-level development fund allocation
indicators.description: Ward-level development fund allocation where separately and officially reported.
indicators.note: Never divide county budgets mechanically by ward count.

indicators.name: Turnout, prior general elections
indicators.description: Voter turnout in prior general elections.
indicators.note: Natural extension of the Sprint 2 electoral architecture; not yet ingested.

indicators.name: Households with electricity (%)
indicators.description: Share of households whose main lighting source indicates electricity access.
indicators.note: County census indicator.

indicators.name: Classified road length (km)
indicators.description: Length of classified road network.
indicators.note: No single clean county table identified.

indicators.name: Households with access to improved water source (%)
indicators.description: Share of households with access to an improved water source.
indicators.note: Utility service areas do not align cleanly with counties; crosswalk required before promotion.

indicators.name: Health facilities per 10,000 population
indicators.description: Atlas-derived facility density from KMHFR geocoded facilities and canonical geography polygons.
indicators.note: When activated, badge B: transparent aggregation of official facility points; never presented as a KMHFR-published area table.

indicators.name: Registered vehicles (count, per capita)
indicators.description: Registered vehicles by county if a public county breakdown is confirmed.
indicators.note: Public county breakdown not confirmed; remain planned.

indicators.name: Mobile money transaction volume
indicators.description: National mobile-money transaction volume for the Kenya Pulse.
indicators.source: Central Bank of Kenya / Communications Authority
indicators.note: National-only Pulse slot; no county breakdown identified.
